description: An AI security workspace for code reviews, findings, research and fixes.
changes: First catalog package: 0 0.28.1, FoxGuard 0.14.0, private browser access and persistent workspace state.
notes: Workspace members share access to the files, tools and provider connections in this app.
Use security workflows only on systems you own or are authorized to assess.
Running jobs stop when the sandbox parks. Saved files, findings and sessions persist.
Model usage is billed separately by your provider.
Includes FoxGuard source analysis. Docker, Ghidra, SmolVM and browser automation toolchains are not preinstalled.
